title: Why Asian Grandmas ALWAYS Tell You to Eat More
description: You just finished a huge meal and grandma is already loading your plate again. But the reason is actually really beautiful. What does YOUR grandma always say? Comment!

sections.narration: Imagine you just finished a massive bowl of rice and your Asian grandma says 'eat more.'
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy with full belly, grandma holding rice spoon, warm kitchen

sections.narration: You're literally about to burst, but she's already piling more food on your plate.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy with overflowing plate, grandma adding more, warm dining room

sections.narration: You say you're full, and she looks at you like that's not even a real answer.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy waving hands no, grandma tilting head, warm table setting

sections.narration: So basically, for many Asian grandparents, food is how they say 'I love you.'
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy receiving bowl, heart shapes in steam above, warm kitchen

sections.narration: Many of them grew up in times when having enough food was never guaranteed.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy looking at old photo of grandma as child, warm sepia tones

sections.narration: And it gets deeper — making sure you're well-fed means making sure you're safe and healthy.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy eating happily, grandma watching with warm smile, cozy room

sections.narration: But here's the thing — saying 'no thanks' can feel like rejecting their care.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy politely declining, grandma looking down, warm soft lighting

sections.narration: Every extra spoonful is basically a tiny act of love wrapped in rice.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy and grandma, rice spoon between them, warm golden glow

sections.narration: So THAT'S why she won't stop feeding you — food is her love language, literally.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy with lightbulb, grandma serving food, heart icons, warm

sections.narration: She might not say 'I love you' out loud, but that extra dumpling says it all.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy holding dumpling, grandma smiling proudly, warm family scene

sections.narration: Next time grandma says 'eat more,' just smile and grab another bite for her.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy eating happily with grandma, warm cozy dining table
Centered: boy giving thumbs up, warm earth-toned background, simple
